title: Kaleidoscope Gallery: Exploring Ethics and Generative AI Through Art

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of expert interviews evaluating text-to-image AI generations, observing male-centered depictions of moral exemplars, governance councils, and the imbalanced or sexually offensive representation of women.

Qualitative thematic analysis of expert interviews evaluating text-to-image AI generations, identifying a Western/US-centric framing of global concepts, foregrounding of the Americas, and stereotyped depictions of non-Western global cultures.

Qualitative thematic analysis of expert interviews evaluating text-to-image AI generations, noting the portrayal of rigid social structures, such as pyramidal hierarchies that place the working class at the bottom and a technocratic elite at the top.
